content.description: Webhook endpoint that receives container milestone events from terminals, EDI systems, or manual input. Maps event location to port coordinates when possible and creates iot_container_gps_trackings records with trackingType 'milestone_update'. Enables showing last-known-location of containers on the map without GPS hardware.
capabilities: Accepts: containerNumber, eventType (gate_in, gate_out, vessel_load, vessel_discharge, customs_release, delivered), locationCode (UN/LOCODE), timestamp
Maps locationCode to port lat/lng from mdm_ports table
Supports both authenticated (API key) and HMAC-signed webhook calls
Returns created tracking record ID in response
acceptance_criteria: POST with valid container event returns 201 with tracking record ID
Container appears on map at port location after event + refresh
If locationCode matches a port, lat/lng populated from port data
If locationCode not found, lat/lng left null (record still created with locationName)
Zod validation on request body — returns 422 on invalid payload
Auth: either Bearer token (iot:read) or X-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256
Event types validated against allowed enum
edge_cases: Unknown container number — still creates record (external containers)
Unknown UN/LOCODE — creates record with null lat/lng, sets locationName to the code
Duplicate event (same container + event + timestamp) — idempotent, returns existing record
Very old timestamp (>30 days ago) — still accepted, no time validation
error_handling: Invalid JSON body — 400 with parse error
Missing required fields — 422 with Zod details
No auth and no webhook signature — 401
Invalid webhook signature — 401 with 'Invalid signature' message
